name: [Action Name]
description: [Brief description of what this action does]
author: Kontango Limited

config.description: Updated configuration file path (for chaining actions)

config_schema.description: Configuration file validation - define required and optional fields
config_schema.note: Change these to match your action's config requirements

dependencies.note: Add ANY package your action needs - auto-detected and installed

custom_config.example:
- name: [Action Name]
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/[action-name]@main
  with:
    config: config/production.json

chaining.example:
- name: First Action
  id: first
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/first-action@main
  with:
    config: .env

- name: [Action Name]
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/[action-name]@main
  with:
    config: ${{ steps.first.outputs.config }}

self_contained.description: Checklist to ensure action is completely self-contained and reusable
checklist: All scripts copied to scripts/ folder
All dependencies listed in dependencies.packages array
Action works when folder is copied standalone

notes: This action-spec.json is the complete descriptor for your action
Replace [Action Name] with your action's display name
Replace [action-name] with your action's directory name
Update config_schema.fields to match your required/optional fields
Add all system packages to dependencies.packages array
For Python/Node packages, add them to dependencies.packages (e.g., python3-requests)
Delete schema.json after moving fields to config_schema
Keep this file well-documented for reusability
